we have developed a novel HTPD platform for developing chromatographic steps.
a novel, high‐throughput, high‐productivity platform has been developed for performing chromatography process development studies.
a high throughput process development (HTDP) platform has been developed for process optimization of chromatography steps and the platform is validated for its scalability.

the development of a HTPD platform for chromatographic separations.
the development of a novel high‐throughput platform for the development of chromatography steps.
the development of high‐throughput tools for bioprocessing and the application of these tools to the development of biopharmaceuticals.

the proposed HTPD platform has been shown to be a viable tool for performing process development studies for chromatography steps.

the high‐throughput platform developed in this study is capable of performing process development studies for a chromatographic step at 170‐ to 300‐fold higher productivity compared to traditional laboratory scale.
the HTPD approach has the potential to significantly reduce the time and effort required for developing a chromatography step.

the HTPD process development platform developed by us is a useful tool for performing the process optimization at high productivity and is capable of providing a qualitative assessment of the effects that the various input parameters have on the process performance.
we have demonstrated the utility of a high‐ throughput process development (HTDP) platform for establishing “design space” for a chromatography step.
we have developed a platform for process development in chromatographic steps.

we have developed a high‐throughout process development (HT‐PD) platform for the optimization of the process chromatographic unit operation.
the high‐throughput (HT) platform that we have developed can be used to perform process optimization studies at much higher productivity.
the HTPD approach is a very powerful tool for process development and characterization.
